metadata.description: Ground truth about npm and PyPI packages for coding agents: hallucinated and slopsquatted names are caught before they are installed.

plugins.name: pkgtruth
plugins.description: MCP server the agent can ask about a package, plus a PreToolUse hook that denies npm/npx/pnpm/yarn/bun/pip/uv/poetry installs of hallucinated or slopsquatted names.
